description: This file defines the class Scenario2Nested3, a concrete implementation of the Scenario2Nested interface used for setting up a specific test scenario involving policy and permission checks in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It initializes a scenario setup object with attributes such as description, policies, and permission checks, particularly focusing on subject permissions for a resource attribute.

classes.name: Scenario2Nested3
classes.description: A class representing a specific test scenario setup where a subject has granted permissions, used in benchmarking or testing the Ditto framework's policy enforcement.

methods.name: Scenario2Nested3
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the scenario setup with permission details, resource path, and verification logic.
